decisions.reason: The $48 flat secondary royalty does not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or expired-ticket state follows the NFT after transfer.
The secondary royalty amount and disclosure do not change the selected Base network.
The royalty decision does not require the royalty amount or disclosure to appear in NFT metadata and does not alter any current metadata attribute.
The existing same-message FAQ introduction already requires loading the complete supplied copy and includes mint and royalty fees among its topics.
The flat royalty on secondary sales does not change the $10 commission triggered by a referral-coded mint.
The secondary royalty decision does not change Transak, its supported fiat methods, or wallet and cryptocurrency prerequisites for primary minting.
The secondary royalty amount and disclosure do not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.

The Small Block state already records that secondary royalties contribute to its pool; specifying a $48 flat royalty does not necessarily change the draw rule or establish how much of that royalty enters the pool.
The secondary royalty decision does not change badge thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment.
The royalty amount and disclosure do not change the randomness provider, draw applicability, or verification method.
The secondary royalty decision does not affect the deferred Discord launch condition.
This candidate governs primary-mint pricing and allocation; the $48 flat royalty applies to secondary sales and does not alter the recorded primary-mint values.
